name: StartInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to start.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要启用的堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the bastion host is bound
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机实例绑定的交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the bastion host
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the security groups to which the bastion host is bound
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机实例绑定的安全组ID列表
parameters.name: security_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the security groups for the endpoint that is used to access the bastion host over a private network
parameters.help_zh: 私网连接终端节点安全组 ID 列表
parameters.name: client_security_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secondary vSwitch to which the bastion host is bound
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机实例绑定的备用交换机 ID
parameters.name: slave_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the O\&M portal of the bastion host to be accessed over a private network
parameters.help_zh: 开启私网运维门户访问
parameters.name: enable_portal_private_access
